name: Flores Festival
desc: The village plaza is draped with sampaguita and gumamela arches. Villagers wear light barongs and baro't saya for community blessings and traditional games.

name: Pista ng Ani
desc: Farmers from across the valley bring their proudest baskets of palay, kalabasa, and kamote to the plaza stage to compete for the golden harvest ribbon.

name: Araw ng Bayanihan
desc: Long banana leaves are laid across plaza banquet tables piled with steamed rice, grilled vegetables, and fresh fruits. Everyone eats together with their hands.

name: Barangay Fiesta Maliwanag
desc: Bright banderitas flutter overhead, string lights illuminate the plaza at night, and acoustic guitars fill the air with joy and romance as the community dances.
